title: Fundamentals of Deep Learning
description: Master the building blocks of modern deep learning. Implement and train image classifiers (CNNs), sequence models, and text classifiers using TensorFlow and Keras. Apply data augmentation, batch normalization, dropout, and transfer learning. Complete in an interactive GPU-accelerated JupyterLab environment provided by NVIDIA.

title: Fundamentals of Accelerated Computing with CUDA Python
description: Accelerate Python programs using CUDA-capable GPUs. Learn parallel programming fundamentals — thread/block/grid hierarchy, memory coalescing, and synchronization primitives — using Numba and CuPy. Achieve 10–100x performance improvements over CPU-only code in data science and scientific computing workloads.

title: Fundamentals of Accelerated Computing with CUDA C/C++
description: Write GPU-accelerated C/C++ programs using the CUDA programming model. Covers CUDA kernel syntax, memory management (global, shared, texture memory), thread synchronization, streams, and asynchronous execution. Profile and optimize GPU applications with Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute.

title: Generative AI Explained
description: Demystify generative AI for practitioners and decision-makers. Understand the mechanics of large language models (LLMs), diffusion models for image generation, and multimodal AI. Covers prompt engineering, temperature/sampling parameters, AI hallucinations, bias, and real-world applications across healthcare, finance, and engineering.

title: Building Transformer-Based NLP Applications
description: Build production NLP systems using transformer architectures. Implement BERT for token classification, text classification, and question answering. Fine-tune pre-trained models from HuggingFace using NVIDIA's NeMo toolkit and deploy optimized inference with TensorRT on GPU infrastructure.

title: Building RAG Agents with LLMs
description: Build production-ready Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Implement document parsing, semantic chunking, vector embeddings (NVIDIA Embed), FAISS/Milvus vector databases, and LangChain orchestration pipelines. Deploy a fully functional AI assistant that answers questions over private enterprise documents.

title: Applications of AI for Computer Vision
description: Deploy real-world computer vision models — object detection (YOLOv8), semantic segmentation (DeepLabV3+), image classification, and multi-camera tracking. Use NVIDIA DeepStream SDK for streaming video analytics pipelines, and Triton Inference Server for scalable model deployment.

title: Scaling and Deploying Deep Learning Models
description: Scale deep learning training across multi-GPU and multi-node clusters. Learn data parallelism, model parallelism, gradient compression, mixed-precision training (FP16/BF16), and efficient checkpointing. Use NVIDIA Megatron-LM and NeMo for training billion-parameter language models.

title: Robotics Simulation with Isaac Sim
description: Develop and test autonomous robot behaviors in NVIDIA Isaac Sim — a physically accurate, ray-traced simulation environment. Covers ROS 2 integration, synthetic data generation for training perception models, reinforcement learning for robot control, and bridging simulation to real hardware (sim-to-real transfer).

title: Optimizing and Deploying LLMs with TensorRT-LLM
description: Optimize and deploy large language models for production inference. Covers INT4/INT8/FP8 quantization, KV-cache optimization, speculative decoding, tensor parallelism, and batching strategies using NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM and Triton Inference Server. Benchmark and achieve enterprise-grade throughput and latency SLAs.
